text: dsh-plugin-local-life 是面向 DSH agent 的日常生活计算工具插件，通过注册 local_life 工具并添加可选的提示指导，按动作处理预算规划、账单分摊、单价比较、折扣计算、单位换算、旅行清单、支出汇总、贷款摊还、商品折扣比较和食谱成本估算。用户可提交相应数字、类别、商品或食材信息，获得计算结果或清单。适合在 DSH 对话中进行个人预算、购物、做饭及出行准备。不需要额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-plugin-local-life adds local_life to DSH agents for budgeting, bill splitting, shopping calculations, conversions, expense summaries, loan schedules, recipe costs, and trip checklists. Users provide figures or item details and get results in chat. No API key or external service is needed.
帮我按收入和各类开销做一个月度预算，算出还能剩多少。
几个人一起吃饭，能不能算上小费后每人该付多少？
比较不同包装的单价并估算折扣叠加后的价格。
dsh-plugin-local-life 的功能「预算与账单计算」：调用 local_life 工具的 budget 或 split 动作，输入月收入与分类金额/比例，或账单总额、人数及可选权重和小费，返回预算分配余额或每人分摊金额。

dsh-plugin-local-life README · dsh-plugin-local-life：A **local-life toolkit** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) agents: budgets, bill splitting, unit prices, discounts, unit conversions, and trip checklists. Everyday arithmetic, done right.

dsh-plugin-local-life README · Compatibility：Tool schemas are validated against the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` value-schema DSL at plugin load (checked against dsh-tools 0.1.0-rc.6 and 0.1.1-rc.2). Earlier releases used JSON-Schema `required` at the root of `output.schema` and closed nested objects without declared properties, which made the host abort the whole profile boot with `unsupported JSON schema: schema.required is not supported by the value schema DSL` and could reject the tool's own results. Current releases fix both; if an affected version left your DSH unable to start, remove the plugin from the profile (or upgrade) — no data is lost.

dsh-plugin-local-life README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-plugin-local-life
```

Restart DSH. The `local_life` tool is registered host-wide.

dsh-plugin-local-life README · Tool：| action | purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `budget` | Monthly budget plan from income and category amounts/percentages, with savings and leftover |
| `split` | Split a bill equally or by weights, optional tip and rounding |
| `price` | Unit-price comparison (e.g. price per kg / per 100g) |
| `discount` | Percent-off or amount-off (with threshold) math |
| `convert` | Unit conversion — weight (斤/kg/磅), length (里/km/尺/英里), volume (L/加仑), temperature (°C/°F) |
| `checklist` | Trip/outing checklist by scenario (city / airport / outdoor / self-drive) |
| `ledger` | Expense-ledger summary — totals by category and month |
| `loan` | Loan amortization — equal-payment or equal-principal schedules, monthly payment and total interest |
| `compare` | Spec-normalized unit-price comparison and stacked discounts/thresholds |
| `recipe_cost` | Recipe cost from ingredients — total and per-serving |

dsh-plugin-local-life README · Config：All optional, on the composition row's `config`:

| key | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `personaSection` | `true` | register the local-life prompt-guidance section |
| `sectionOrder` | `6` | prompt section order (persona is 0, ascending) |

dsh-plugin-local-life README · Design：Pure logic (`lib/local.js`) has zero DSH/Cordis imports and is unit-tested in isolation; `lib/index.js` is the thin Cordis plugin wiring the tool and the prompt section. No filesystem access — deterministic and side-effect free.

dsh-plugin-local-life README · Roadmap：See [ROADMAP.md](./ROADMAP.md) — next five versions (v0.2.0 – v0.6.0): ledger & loans, shopping compare & recipe cost, bills calendar & shared ledger, commute & insurance compare, annual report & daily briefing.
